correctness.rationale: Enumerated every one of 2^16 subsets from the actual Shrikhande Cayley difference set: 16,72,96,16 nonempty simplices by dimension. The connected 1-skeleton has d1 rank 15; exact GF2 d2=57 and d3=16 with matching rational upper bounds by d1*d2=0 and column count, giving reduced rational H2 rank 23 and vanishing other reduced rational homology. Independently generated all 12 origin-fixing linear transformations and 16 translations and computed the signed reduced fixed-simplex Euler trace for all 192 affine automorphisms; its frequency distribution was exactly {-7:12,-3:4,-1:69,0:32,1:24,2:32,3:18,23:1}. Translation Fourier multiplicities and full group invariant sums matched the submitted four dual orbit and little-group classification. The source gives explicit stabilizer characters; no integral representation decomposition is asserted.
